episodes.title: Pilot
episodes.summary: A charming first encounter quickly turns into something more nefarious when bookstore manager Joe takes a very strong liking to grad student Beck.

episodes.title: The Last Nice Guy in New York
episodes.summary: As Beck deals with unwanted advances from her advisor, she brings Joe to Peach's high society soiree. Joe tries to navigate matters with Benji.

episodes.title: Maybe
episodes.summary: Beck's continued casual encounters catch Joe off guard, as does a run-in with the police. Both make him realize a key situation must be dealt with.

episodes.title: The Captain
episodes.summary: After an awkward evening with Beck, Joe discovers he's not the only one keeping secrets. Peach's antagonistic approach to Joe intensifies.

episodes.title: Living with the Enemy
episodes.summary: A video from Annika's past comes back to haunt her. Joe and Peach's simmering tension boils over when Peach introduces Beck to a major literary agent.

episodes.title: Amour Fou
episodes.summary: Beck heads to Connecticut with Peach, whose motives are not what they seem. Joe's pursuit of her stirs up old memories -- and brings new injuries.

episodes.title: Everythingship
episodes.summary: A grieving Beck turns to therapy, which leads Joe to do the same -- for different reasons. Joe's plans for Beck's birthday don't go as expected.

episodes.title: You Got Me, Babe
episodes.summary: Three months later, life is good for Joe and Beck, respectively. But a series of reconnections may spell trouble for Joe's current relationship.

episodes.title: Candace
episodes.summary: So, what exactly happened to Candace? Beck is determined to find out -- but to do so, she'll have to take a page straight from Joe's book.

episodes.title: Bluebeard's Castle
episodes.summary: Joe juggles problems with Paco and Beck -- and now must contend with a private investigator as well. But resolution is coming, one way or another.

episodes.title: A Fresh Start
episodes.summary: Joe -- now "Will" -- arrives in his own personal hell on Earth: LA. He's trying to go straight, but the past doesn't always leave well enough alone.

episodes.title: Just the Tip
episodes.summary: Joe realizes Will Bettelheim isn't all he's cracked up to be. The fallout threatens to get in the way of his burgeoning connection with Love.

episodes.title: What Are Friends For?
episodes.summary: Joe attempts to keep things platonic with Love and keep his nose out of Ellie's business. But his instincts soon get the better of him.

episodes.title: The Good, the Bad, & the Hendy
episodes.summary: As he tries to adapt to sharing Love with Forty, Joe is caught off guard by a group date -- while his protectiveness of Ellie quickly escalates.

episodes.title: Have a Good Wellkend, Joe!
episodes.summary: Love brings Joe to a wellness weekend, where he gets a good look at her family's dynamic. But Forty's surprise guest has him feeling anything but zen.

episodes.title: Farewell, My Bunny
episodes.summary: Joe performs surveillance on a potential problem, but suspects someone might be tailing him, too. Painful memories put Love on edge about the present.

episodes.title: Ex-istential Crisis
episodes.summary: To soothe heartache, Joe turns to ancient remedies, modern technology and drinking with Delilah. But one small slip-up could have major consequences.

episodes.title: Fear and Loathing in Beverly Hills
episodes.summary: Joe wants to get away, but Forty insists they finish their script. As pressure mounts, Forty's excessive coping devices make for a harrowing night.

episodes.title: P.I. Joe
episodes.summary: As Love looks after an increasingly skittish Ellie, Joe tries to reconstruct the events of a trippy evening -- but finds the truth to be elusive.

episodes.title: Love, Actually
episodes.summary: Joe has always been full of surprises, but Love has a few of her own. Is this the beginning of the end, or the end of the deceiving?

episodes.title: And They Lived Happily Ever After
episodes.summary: After a delivery room surprise, new dad Joe struggles to connect with his infant child, but he has no trouble at all fostering a new infatuation.

episodes.title: So I Married an Axe Murderer
episodes.summary: Joe and Love try couples therapy, but their issues may need more than counseling — and their friction isn't the only thing they need to make disappear.

episodes.title: Missing White Woman Syndrome
episodes.summary: Love grows apprehensive as media scrutiny intensifies next door. An acute sickness in the family drudges up old memories — and worse — for Joe.

episodes.title: Hands Across Madre Linda
episodes.summary: An impulsive retaliation by Love lands her and Joe in a bind. Though Joe seeks a different way out than usual, it proves to be a tall order.

episodes.title: Into the Woods
episodes.summary: Joe begrudgingly goes on a hunting trip with some other local husbands as Love tries to manage her burgeoning relationship with Theo.

episodes.title: W.O.M.B.
episodes.summary: As her mother launches a new venture, Love grows increasingly concerned about a potential big change herself. Joe has a breakthrough in self-awareness.

episodes.title: We're All Mad Here
episodes.summary: While Dottie spirals into emotional turmoil, Love tries to get intel on Matthew's investigation. Joe sets his sights on derailing Marienne's ex.

episodes.title: Swing and a Miss
episodes.summary: Joe selfishly tries to coerce Love into a lifestyle change, but things go south quickly. Theo discovers just how deep Matthew's obsession goes.

episodes.title: Red Flag
episodes.summary: While Love tends to some unexpected long-term guests, Joe decides to take a drastic step to get what he wants the most.

episodes.title: What Is Love?
episodes.summary: As news permeates the community about a recent murder, Joe looks toward a future with Marienne — but hell hath no fury like Love scorned.

episodes.title: Joe Takes a Holiday
episodes.summary: Now living in London, Joe tries to lay low and resist old habits... until he's forced to tie up loose ends and bond with a circle of wealthy socialites.

episodes.title: Portrait of the Artist
episodes.summary: Joe leans on his skills — and a student's insights — to catch his stalker. An art show offers a gallery of suspects, revealing more than the eye can see.

episodes.title: Eat the Rich
episodes.summary: As news of a killer targeting the rich swirls, Joe's stalker inches dangerously close to the truth. Joe's efforts to protect Kate take a dark turn.

episodes.title: Hampsie
episodes.summary: A ritzy weekend getaway doubles as a chance for Joe to hunt down his elusive stalker. Without cell service or Wi-Fi, Joe makes a key connection.

episodes.title: The Fox and the Hound
episodes.summary: While falling back into familiar patterns, Joe gets caught up in an unfortunate game as everyone's plans go up in flames.

episodes.title: Best of Friends
episodes.summary: In the aftermath of the murders, Joe searches for a scapegoat and Rhys pursues his grand ambitions while Kate and Phoebe assert their independence.

episodes.title: Good Man, Cruel World
episodes.summary: The tables turn for Joe when an influential figure comes to town with a tempting offer as Nadia follows a hunch.

episodes.title: Where Are You Going, Where Have You Been?
episodes.summary: As memories of the past trickle in, Joe struggles to recall an important detail. Phoebe shares her hasty plans with Kate. Nadia scrambles for a solution.

episodes.title: She's Not There
episodes.summary: Torn between his dark side and good intentions, Joe works to right his wrongs. After attempting to help Phoebe, Kate faces her father — and hard truths.

episodes.title: The Death of Jonathan Moore
episodes.summary: With love and loss weighing heavily on his mind, Joe commits a final act in hopes of never walking down the same path again.

episodes.title: The Luckiest Guy in NY
episodes.summary: Joe and Kate settle in New York with a pledge to start over, but their headline-making marriage hits a snag when betrayal strikes close to home.

episodes.title: Blood Will Have Blood
episodes.summary: A family dinner descends into chaos when Kate's sister Reagan makes a shocking allegation. Bronte's curiosity lands her in a tight spot.

episodes.title: Impostor Syndrome
episodes.summary: Joe hits an impasse in Mooney's basement, as tension builds at home. Kate plays hardball to protect Henry. Bronte faces exposure at a literary salon.

episodes.title: My Fair Maddie
episodes.summary: A game-changing announcement at Lockwood Corporation sets off alarm bells for Kate. An unwelcome guest crashes Mooney's grand reopening.

episodes.title: Last Dance
episodes.summary: Fueled by fear, Kate finds answers from a troubled source. A puzzling note at work sends Joe on a search for the whereabouts of a missing person.

episodes.title: The Dark Face of Love
episodes.summary: A viral video complicates Joe's dreams of a fresh start — and forces Bronte to question her loyalties. Kate makes changes at home.

episodes.title: #JoeGoldberg
episodes.summary: As faces from his past resurface, the "most visible man in New York" must sway the court of public opinion.

episodes.title: Folie a Deux
episodes.summary: With their relationship at a crossroads, Joe gives Bronte a gift to test her commitment. Kate finds a shoulder to lean on.

episodes.title: Trial of the Furies
episodes.summary: Joe must use all his talents to liberate himself from the Lockwoods' financial grip. Kate tries a dose of deception to achieve her goal.

episodes.title: Finale
episodes.summary: Hoping to decisively close the book on the past, Joe embarks on a risky new chapter. But as with every great story, one last twist awaits.
